title: Product Comparison Videos for Clearer Choices | AIVideosUGC
description: Show shoppers the difference between your colors, sizes, or sets. One photo of both options becomes a comparison clip for listings, YouTube Shorts and paid ads.
h1: Make a Product Comparison Video Shoppers Can Judge
lead: Use one photo that already shows both options, then add a voice and a script so the difference is the whole clip.
steps_h2: How to Make a Product Comparison Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One photo of both options, a short script about the difference, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Upload one photo with both options fully in the picture and at a similar scale. Even light keeps the difference easy to see.
Name the difference, pick a size and 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and add a short script.
Add the option names in the editor, download the file with no watermark, and post it.

faq.q: What is a product comparison video?
faq.a: A clip that puts two options you can see in one picture, so a shopper can judge the difference. You bring one photo that already shows both.

faq.q: How do I make a product comparison video?
faq.a: Upload that photo, name the difference, add or edit a script and a voice, pick a size and a length, then download.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a studio day?
faq.a: The clip is built from the photo you already have. You skip another shoot when both options are already in that photo. An on-screen person can point at the difference.

faq.q: Who is a product comparison video for?
faq.a: Shops that sell two sizes, colors, finishes, or a set. The choice should be easy to see on a listing, a YouTube Short, TikTok, Instagram, or a paid ad.
Yes. No editing experience is required. Put both options in one clear photo, then adjust the script in the built-in editor.
One sharp photo with both options complete, at a similar scale, in even light. A photo of only one option cannot show the comparison.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photo and start from a link?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your own photo of both options, or paste the product page link to write a first script and pick the on-screen person. You can also send the photo through the API, which is how your own shop software starts it.

faq.q: Which size, length and platforms can I use?
faq.a: Use a square (1:1), a wide screen (16:9), a tall phone video (9:16), a classic photo (4:3), or a tall photo (3:4). Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Post the file on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or the product page.

No. There is no free plan. A credit is a unit your plan spends. A clip costs 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. If the clip fails, those credits come back. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I use the file commercially?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark and can be used in your listings and paid ads. If a person appears, the tool made that person. They are not a customer. Add names and prices in the editor.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of building the ad from nothing?
faq.a: The scene already holds both options in one picture, so you can spend your time on the difference shoppers should notice. You can still make a second version for another audience or language.

faq.q: Can the voice be in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Make the same comparison with a voice in another language, and approve the words before you post.

steps.sourceTitle: Two Sizes of a Matte Storage Canister
steps.sourceHint: Keep the small and large slate-gray canisters, rounded lids and blank surfaces fully visible.
steps.prompt: An adult raises a small and a large gray canister to the same height.
